Push uses the New York neighborhood theme to bring a new concept to an old word.  NYC has many, many neighborhoods.  They derive their names from a variety of sources, including abbreviations such as SoHo in the example – South of Houston Street.

Parts of the two areas Pusha T uses in this line (tri- and -ho) translate to three hoes.  If you combine the concepts of three hoes (tri-) and perfection (-fecta) in a similar way, you get trifecta.
